# Mathlete learning tools

Interactive math games I built for Mathlete MTB, my math and physics tutoring for young athletes. Each one puts students in a mountain-bike scenario and runs at six levels, from Algebra I through Calculus. about mathlete mtb →

  • >Gear Ratio Lab

    A race-mechanic game: students choose a chainring, wheel and cogs for each section of a mountain-bike course, work out the ratios, speeds and times, then race their setup against a rival's.

    status: live
    • education
    • tutoring
    • game
    • mountain-biking

  • >Strava Showdown

    A race-analyst game: students call the podium from a field of riders' ride data, crunch each rider's stats, plot them on a distance–time graph, and defend their final call with numbers.

    status: live
    • education
    • tutoring
    • game
    • mountain-biking

  • >Trail Builder

    A trail-crew game: students take a client's work order, solve the math for every trail segment they build, and have to land exactly on the finish elevation within budget.

    status: live
    • education
    • tutoring
    • game
    • mountain-biking
